timelineStep1Description: We take a deep dive into your brand, target audience, industry standards and competitors to begin the planning and design process.
timelineStep2Description: Using the research, inspiration and brand assets, your website strategy, site plan and home page design concept is created.
timelineStep3Description: Once the strategy and design of your home page has been approved the rest of the internal website pages are designed to suit your content.
timelineStep4Description: During the quality phase, your website is optimised for mobile responsiveness, site speed and checked to make sure everything is perfect for launch.
timelineStep5Description: Pop the Prosecco! After your hand-over and training, your brand new website is ready to launch.
